playoff.note: single promotion place; champion and runner-up are promoted directly

boundaries.note: T2: champion and runner-up up directly, 3rd-6th play off for the third place. T1: bottom three relegated directly, no play-out.

conflicts.note: Thailand played spring-to-autumn until 2019; since 2020-21 the season is autumn/spring, so the current season is 2026-27.

notes: Both sizes and levels match our rows. THA2 is closed_down only because Thai League 3 (level 3, three regional divisions) is not in our rows: in reality its bottom three go down there. THA2 promotion is 2 direct + 1 play-off, so a career sim must not promote a flat top three. Seasons run August to May; there is no winter break of note.
